knobs.note: BH-3685: probes per episode, P0 and P1 included; the bisect gets this minus 2 (2 means a bisect budget of 0, which answers bounded). Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_MAX_STEPS:-8}; an invalid or out-of-range value falls back to 8.

BH-3685: the most first-parent merges between green and red the lane will bisect; more is recorded bounded with a warn and no bisect. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_MAX_MERGES:-40}.
BH-3685: the most one probe may run its suites. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_SUITE_TIMEOUT_S:-900}, validated and exported for mrb_probe (bin/lib/mrb-probe.sh).

BH-3685: 1 lets the act open a revert PR for a culprit merge, 0 turns that off. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_REVERT:-1}, validated and exported for the act functions (bin/lib/mrb-act.sh).

BH-3685: the most suites the act may quarantine for one episode, 0 turns quarantine off. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_QUARANTINE_MAX:-3}, validated and exported for the act functions (bin/lib/mrb-act.sh).

BH-3685: the ERE of suite paths the act must never quarantine. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_PROTECTED_RE:-…} and exported for the act functions (bin/lib/mrb-act.sh). NOT settable from the control plane: narrowing it would let the act quarantine a ratchet, approval, spend, brake or merge suite.

BH-3685: the repos the lane walks, space or comma separated. Empty (the default) means $HARNESS_REPO. Any slug other than the harness repo is logged unsupported and skipped. Read by bin/main-red-bisect.sh as ${MAIN_RED_BISECT_REPOS:-$HARNESS_REPO}. NOT settable from the control plane: it names repos a root lane checks out and runs suites in.

Test seam: a file bin/main-red-bisect.sh sources after the contract libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (tests/main-red-bisect.bh-3685-test.sh). NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/main-red-bisect.sh sources MAIN_RED_BISECT_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
